milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the yellow bed and face it to demonstrate visual identification. Target is the bed foot at (5,0,4) which has the prominent yellow surface facing the player's approach. max_distance=5 ensures the player must walk at least ~1.4 blocks from spawn (spawn-to-bed distance is ~6.4 blocks), preventing trivial completion from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is actually looking at the bed, not just passing by.
